'''Hedrett oil-rig whiskey''' was a type of alcoholic beverage. When the [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal [[Vex (Human)|Vex]] interrogated [[Gust Toruna]], he let Toruna have a swig of oil-rig whiskey. It cleared his mouth, allowing him to tell Vex about how he and some associates were attacked by enforcers working for [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].

It was presumably named after the city of [[Hedrett]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
